fields.acceptance: A Go test in internal/api (beside web_root_test.go) registers two initialised projects under one root, each with a milestone change set and a backlog change set (one depending on another), serves WebRootHandler, GETs /p/<a>/roadmap and /p/<b>/roadmap, extracts every row href, asserts each is under that project's /p/<project>/changes/ prefix and names none of the other project's change sets, GETs each and gets 200, then GETs every depends-on link on those change pages and gets 200. go test -trimpath ./internal/api/... ./internal/web/... passes
fields.statement: Under a Rhiza root, every row on each project's web roadmap (/p/<project>/roadmap: milestone, umbrella and backlog groups) and every depends-on link on its change set pages opens that project's change set page (/p/<project>/changes/<id>), never a 404
